Padma Bhushan award belongs to Ezhava community, says Vellappally Natesan

Vellappally Natesan, a leader associated with the Ezhava community, stated that the Padma Bhushan award conferred upon him belongs to the entire Ezhava community. He emphasized that the recognition is not personal but a tribute to the community's contributions. Natesan's statements clarify the context of the award, attributing the honor to the collective identity and achievements of the Ezhava people.
